column2: six tiles: Musik (SD songs, radio), Info (robot status, weather, prayer times, news, calendar, exchange rates, Wikipedia), Alat (motion modes, camera), Main (rock-paper-scissors), Pesan (messages), and Setelan (settings). Tiles that are still grey come in the next stage. Buttons act when your finger lifts; the ◀ button at top left goes back
current temperature, the next 12 hours (temperature and rain-chance bars), and the next 3 days, from Open-Meteo for the location in CUACA_LAT/CUACA_LON
Screen: Info → Jadwal sholat (prayer times), or Telegram /sholat

today's prayer times with a countdown to the next one and the Hijri date, calculated by api.aladhan.com using the Indonesian Ministry of Religious Affairs method for the same location as the weather. The Pengingat (reminder) button: off, voice ("Sudah masuk waktu Dzuhur"), or voice + adhan from the SD card (/adzan.mp3; Subuh uses /adzan_subuh.mp3 if present). The AI also knows this schedule, so you can ask "jam berapa maghrib?" (what time is maghrib?)

latest news headlines from the Antara, CNN Indonesia, or Antara Technology RSS feeds (pick in the top tabs). Tap a headline to read its summary, BACAKAN to hear it. The source list is SUMBER_BERITA in the code

monthly calendar, today highlighted in blue. Public holidays and collective leave days for 2026-2027 follow the joint ministerial decree (SKB 3 Menteri) (list in DAFTAR_LIBUR; add the next year once its decree is published)
rupiah rates for USD, EUR, SGD, MYR, SAR, JPY (per 100), CNY, AUD from ExchangeRate-API (free, updated once a day, mid-market rates, not bank buy/sell rates)
Screen: Info → Wikipedia, or Telegram /wiki Gunung Rinjani
tap CARI DENGAN SUARA (search by voice) and say the topic; the article summary shows on the screen and can be read aloud. Results from AI searches ("siapa Sultan Hasanuddin?") also appear here

Prayer times differ 1-3 minutes from your local mosque: fill SHOLAT_KOREKSI with extra minutes for Imsak, Subuh, Sunrise, Dzuhur, Ashar, Maghrib, Sunset, Isya, Midnight, separated by commas. Example "2,2,-2,2,2,2,0,2,0" adds 2 minutes to prayer times and subtracts 2 minutes from sunrise.
News, exchange rates, or prayer times say "gagal diambil (kode -1)" (failed to fetch): the WiFi is weak or the site is busy. Leave and reopen the screen a few minutes later.
